cases.title: Reference-only output boundary
cases.expected: Return still/reference prompts and structured references only; no direct text-to-video prompt or rendered video claim.
cases.oracle: No video-generator instruction for continuous scene generation; no render/export claim.

cases.title: Master style reference
cases.expected: Create one master visual-language prompt tied to S05 Guide ID/version.
cases.oracle: Prompt contains style, palette, material, light, composition and prohibited drift; lock version traceable.

cases.title: Character sheet reference
cases.expected: Create still/reference prompts for canonical character appearance, expressions and poses.
cases.oracle: Stable character ID, Guide version, allowed variations and negative constraints are present.

cases.title: Environment and prop references
cases.expected: Create reference prompts and IDs for recurring environments and props.
cases.oracle: Asset IDs resolve to manifest records; absent generated files remain placeholders.

cases.title: Scene keyframe reference
cases.expected: Each selected shot receives a still/keyframe prompt, not an instruction to generate a moving clip.
cases.oracle: Prompt describes one captured state/composition with scene/shot IDs and relevant locks.

cases.title: Motion separated from image prompt
cases.expected: Motion path, transforms, key states and timing remain in S07 structured reference data.
cases.oracle: Image prompt contains no end-to-end animation/video generation request; motion record has distinct ID.

cases.title: Exact text as overlay data
cases.expected: Dates, health claims, institutional name, logo and CTA are supplied separately for later renderer overlay.
cases.oracle: Exact text values trace to source/fact locks and are not entrusted to image-model text generation.

cases.title: Reference asset lifecycle
cases.expected: Distinguish prompt drafted, reference generated, selected and approved states.
cases.oracle: No asset is marked CREATED/SELECTED/APPROVED without corresponding evidence.

cases.title: Renderer-neutral scene handoff
cases.expected: Provide scene order, frame/time ranges, reference IDs, layer roles, overlays and audio cue mapping.
cases.oracle: All IDs and time ranges are valid; no renderer-specific executable code emitted.

cases.title: Remotion schema not assumed
cases.expected: Describe possible mapping to Remotion props/compositions while requiring downstream schema adaptation.
cases.oracle: No claim that generic manifest is directly executable; no TSX or render command unless separately requested.

cases.title: Missing renderer selected
cases.expected: Proceed with renderer-neutral references and label renderer as unspecified.
cases.oracle: No target-specific feature claims or implementation paths are invented.

cases.title: Downstream render absent
cases.expected: Mark render and artifact QA as NOT_RUN, while allowing reference handoff readiness where appropriate.
cases.oracle: No video completion, render or artifact pass is claimed.

cases.title: Renderer-specific implementation requested separately
cases.expected: Treat TSX/project/render implementation as a separate scoped task requiring target repo/schema/environment and explicit scope.
cases.oracle: Reference-only contract remains intact; implementation is not silently added to ordinary output.
